new <- plant.summary %>% filter(str_detect(reportingStatus, "new"))

## Flora of Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound

To date, `r nrow(plant.summary)` vascular plant species have been recorded in the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere
Region, drawing together `r nrow(plants)` records from historical collections, iNaturalist observations and other
sources. Each species falls into one of three groups: *confirmed* species, reported historically and recorded again
in recent searches; *historical* species, reported in the past but not yet found again; and *new* species, first
reported in the region in recent years.

Pick a plant from the list to see only its records on the map, or open *Filters* to narrow the records by recorder.
Open *Records* below the map for the details behind each selection.
